description:
Wait for, read more output from, or cancel a command started by computer_run, computer_browser, computer_use_tool or setup.

WHEN TO USE:
- A previous result had state "running": call this with its job until state is "finished" or "stopped".
- A result had more_output: call this with offset = next_offset to read the rest.
- To stop a command early: cancel: true (ends the command and everything it started).

RETURNS: the same shape as computer_run.

cancel.description: true to end the command now.

computer.description: The computer's name, as computer_list shows it (for example "research").

job.description: The job value from the earlier result.

offset.description: Return output from this byte offset: pass the previous next_offset to get only new output.

name: computer_job
